title: Untitled (OK)
summary: Kruger's imperative second person delivered through window.alert(): the page literally stops until you agree, and the only 'no' is a suppression checkbox granted by the browser vendor.
mechanism: Synchronous window.alert() halts the JS thread and render loop; performance.now() and a requestAnimationFrame counter measure the halt (frames painted: 0) and detect vendor suppression (~0 ms return); RAM only, no storage, no network.
references: Barbara Kruger, Untitled (Your gaze hits the side of my face) (1981)
Barbara Kruger, Untitled (I shop therefore I am) (1987)
JODI (Joan Heemskerk & Dirk Paesmans), alert-box net.art
